phases.title: Repository foundation and evidence baseline
phases.summary: Foundation documentation, owner scope, safety boundaries, and phase status automation reviewed and recorded.

phases.title: Requirements and CPU/GPU/NPU compatibility research
phases.summary: Official package/runtime research and device compatibility limits documented from current local indexes and primary references.

phases.title: Safe native desktop lifecycle
phases.summary: Native lifecycle and preview-first installer passed scoped gates. Current read-only native recheck at 08:16 UTC reconfirmed all 77 recovered XFCE package versions installed at their exact recorded versions; the desktop remains running on :1. The original full pre-consent dependency simulation remains unrecoverable and explicitly documented.
phases.next_action: P2 is complete. Continue P3 ownership and recovery acceptance from the current roadmap; preserve the existing Debian/X11 workflows and keep reboot readiness UNVERIFIED absent explicit owner-approved qualification.

phases.title: Doctor, management, and recovery
phases.summary: P3 exit gates reviewed and passed; RB08 Native cold-boot and authenticated 8023 readiness are documented, checkpoint remains NOT_READY with auto-resume disabled, and the four-client interactive terminal remains staged for P4 by owner decision.
phases.next_action: P3 is complete. Continue the active P4 optional-provider work from the current roadmap and preserve all Native Termux independence gates.

phases.title: Existing Ternux PRoot feature-parity provider
phases.summary: Exact replay-guest retire/restore shares typed Native management operations across CLI, authenticated Web, TUI and installed GTK. Live CLI and real authenticated loopback HTTP cycles preserved exact guest identity and default Debian; GTK preview/confirmation/cancel and GTK selection-result response binding were reviewed on the installed Native app. GTK apply, controlled race injection, browser-rendered controls and remaining P4 provider/terminal gates remain open.
phases.next_action: Complete GTK/VTE same-session attach and remaining provider routes without touching the owner's active PRoot; keep browser-rendered controls and GTK apply explicitly unqualified until exercised.

phases.title: Distro and display compatibility profiles
phases.summary: Only the current Android 16/aarch64/Termux and existing Debian provider profile has device evidence; other combinations remain unqualified.
phases.next_action: After P4, freeze a dated supported profile matrix with exact host, Termux, ABI, distro, display, audio, and graphics versions.

phases.title: CPU/GPU/NPU capability, optimization, and fallback
phases.summary: Native GL/GLES/Vulkan and direct Debian Zink/Turnip draws exist; ordinary workload fallback, clean-install setup, nested presentation, and NPU remain open.
phases.next_action: After P5, connect API-safe backend choice and verified CPU fallback to named workloads, reproduce setup from clean install, and record NPU feasibility.

phases.title: Native apps and curated software catalog
phases.summary: Catalog browse/shortcuts exist, but a supported install/update/remove lifecycle and exact client parity are not complete.
phases.next_action: After P6, select a small official app set and implement preview, consent, progress, update, remove, and result reporting through the shared service and clients.

phases.title: Hybrid workload and accelerator routing
phases.summary: Native, standalone PRoot, and Hybrid features exist separately; accepted boot-to-workload-to-result flows are still missing.
phases.next_action: After P7, verify Native-only, PRoot :0, and Hybrid :1 with selected app and nested :2 workflows, file handoff, audio/display ownership, logs, and recovery.

phases.title: Optional isolated PRoot profile
phases.summary: Optional only: no separate isolated rootfs need is selected; never target the existing Debian installation.
phases.next_action: After P8, proceed only for an owner-approved workload gap; otherwise create Gate: SKIP evidence and use the reviewed skip transition.

phases.title: Hardening, release, and support
phases.summary: Internal completion and public release are separate; supported-profile reproducibility, final docs/security review, license, and provenance remain release gates.
phases.next_action: After required phases, run reproducibility and support checks, update handoff/state, and keep public release blocked until license and provenance are resolved.
